# Vendored office renderer

The Varma control-room floor uses the **photographed office** graphics, not a
lookalike canvas.

## Parcha-ai/ai-office (MIT)

Source: https://github.com/Parcha-ai/ai-office
Upstream: a16z-infra AI Town (https://github.com/a16z-infra/ai-town)

Hari’s screenshots (“AI OFFICE”, teal checkered floor, peach chat panel,
bottom portrait bar) are this renderer’s `/the-office` floor (`rpg-tileset.png`
+ framed window + peach sidebar). License: `ai-office/LICENSE`.

W17ant/Claude-Office `/the-office` is a different isometric room (Slack chat,
Dunder Mifflin day/night PNGs). It does not overlay Hari’s photo, so it is not
used as the floor.

## pixel-agents Metro City characters (MIT)

Source: https://github.com/pixel-agents-hq/pixel-agents
Character art: JIK-A-4, Metro City
https://jik-a-4.itch.io/metrocity-free-topdown-character-pack

Generic pixel people for Varma staff. No sitcom names or TV likenesses.
License: `pixel-agents/LICENSE`.
